token_accounting.representation: compact Unicode JSON-RPC request/reply envelopes with trailing newline; initialized notification has no reply; estimates, not model billing
token_accounting.whole_catalog_included: initialize + initialized notification + tools/list + every trace/continuation/text call
token_accounting.post_discovery: all requests/replies after tools/list; excludes discovery only, not recovery
token_accounting.selected_definitions: complete serialized trace_web_source_location and inspect_analysis_view definitions counted separately; do not add them again to whole-catalog totals; client cached/deferred tool presentation may differ

compiled_tree.encoding: sorted relative UTF-8 filename + NUL + lowercase SHA256 + newline for every regular file, then SHA256

conditions.runs: three fresh-process runs; second trial reverses variant order; OS caches not flushed; no disk-cold claim
conditions.task: all equal-position mappings and exact source/map identity plus 512 UTF-16 units around each mapped point
conditions.comparison: current complete delivery including bounded retained-view overflow recovery versus opt-in summary; not the older export-only fallback

observer.rss: simultaneous ps-snapshot group/tree sums; tree includes linked-PPID codec descendants outside root PGID; can miss short peaks/exited/reparented/orphaned descendants and double-count shared pages
observer.cpu: wait4 user+system waited subtree, excluding sampler and unwaited/orphaned descendants
observer.memory_guard: group early stop; observational tree RSS is not signal authority or a hard/kernel peak limit

hypothetical_input_only_definition_proje: Only {name, description, inputSchema} from captured definitions; not an observed client/model transformation or a measured alternate discovery workflow
